x-m-fill-a-07.title: Bayan An Cire Ƙwallo ta Farko, Shin Yiwuwar ta Biyu Iri Ɗaya ce?
x-m-fill-a-07.topic: Bayanai da dama: yiwuwa (zarewa a jere ba tare da mayar da abin da aka cire ba)
x-m-fill-a-07.goal: Koyi cewa idan aka zare ƙwallo a jere ba tare da mayar da wadda aka zare ba, yiwuwar zare ta biyu tana canzawa bisa sakamakon farko, sannan nemo ka gyara layin warwarewa da bai lura da wannan ba.
x-m-fill-a-07.material: Jaka tana da ƙwallaye ja 2 da shuɗi 3. Ka zare ƙwallo ɗaya ka duba launinta, sannan ba tare da mayar da ita cikin jakar ba ka zare wata. Kowace ƙwallo na da damar zarewa iri ɗaya. (Yadda ake karantawa: 2/5 ana karanta “biyu bisa biyar”.) Jihu ya nemo “yiwuwar ƙwallaye biyun su zama ja” kamar haka.
x-m-fill-a-07.thinking.1: Sake lissafa yiwuwar bisa sauyin ƙwallayen cikin jaka
x-m-fill-a-07.thinking.2: Tsara jaka da kanka da ta cika sharuɗɗa
x-m-fill-a-07.prereq.0: Ma'anar yiwuwa da nemo yiwuwar ta amfani da yawan lokuta
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko da ya yi kuskure a warwarewar Jihu. (An ƙidaya layuka daga 1.)
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, rubuta “ƙwallaye nawa ne a jakar a wannan lokaci, kuma nawa daga cikinsu ja ne.”
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta lambobin da ka rubuta layi bayan layi da ainihin jakar bayan an zare ƙwallon.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.line.0: Yiwuwar ƙwallon farko da aka zare ta zama ja ita ce 2 cikin 5, wato 2/5.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.line.1: Ko da an zare ƙwallon ja da farko, yiwuwar zare ja a karo na biyu ita ce 2/5, daidai da farkon.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.line.2: Domin duka biyun su zama ja, dole ne abubuwan biyu su faru, saboda haka a ninka yiwuwarsu: 2/5 × 2/5 = 4/25.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka yiwuwar ƙwallaye biyun su zama ja ita ce 4/25.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren farko yana layi na 2. Idan an zare ƙwallo ta farko ba tare da mayar da ita ba, ƙwallayen jakar sun bambanta da na farko. Dole ne a sake nemo yiwuwar karo na biyu bisa wannan hali. Hanyar ninka yiwuwar a layi na 3 daidai ce, amma an yi amfani da ƙimar layi na 2, don haka sakamakon ba daidai ba ne. Layi na 4 ya kwafi sakamakon layi na 3. Layi na 1 daidai ne.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, ƙirƙiri jaka da ƙwallaye ja r da shuɗi b. Idan aka zare ƙwallaye biyu ba tare da mayarwa ba, nemo nau'i-nau'i (r, b) guda 3 daban-daban da yiwuwar duka biyun ja take aƙalla 1/6 kuma aƙalla ƙasa da 1/3. (r da b lambobin halitta ne aƙalla 1, kuma r+b bai wuce 10 ba.)
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi guda, sannan bayan an zare ja a farko rubuta ƙwallayen da suka rage da ja nawa ne, sannan ka nemo yiwuwar ta biyu.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rarraba jakunkuna masu r+b iri ɗaya, sauya r ka lissafa yiwuwar a tebur, sannan zaɓi waɗanda suka shiga iyakar.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.ok.c1: r da b lambobin halitta ne aƙalla 1, kuma jimillar ƙwallaye ba ta wuce 10.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.fail.c1: r da b dole ne lambobin halitta aƙalla 1, kuma r+b dole ne bai wuce 10 ba.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Yiwuwar duka biyun su zama ja aƙalla 1/6 ce.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Yiwuwar duka biyun ja ba ta kai 1/6 ba. Bayan an zare ja da farko, sake nemo yiwuwar ta biyu bisa jakar da ta rage.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Yiwuwar duka biyun su zama ja bai wuce 1/3 ba.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Yiwuwar duka biyun ja ta fi 1/3. Bayan an zare ja da farko, sake nemo yiwuwar ta biyu bisa jakar da ta rage.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s2.explain: Yiwuwar duka biyun ja ita ce r/(r+b) × (r−1)/(r+b−1). Misali, (3, 3) yana ba da 3/6 × 2/5 = 1/5, wanda ya kai aƙalla 1/6 kuma bai wuce 1/3 ba. (3, 4) yana ba da 3/7 × 2/6 = 1/7, wanda yake wajen iyakar; amma idan ka lissafa kamar an mayar da ƙwallon, (3/7)²≈0.18, zai yi kama da yana ciki. Nau'i-nau'i (r, b) da suka cika sharuddan sun haɗa da (2,2), (3,2), (3,3), (4,3), (4,4), (4,5), (5,4), (5,5), (6,4), da sauransu.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.prompt: Ka rubuta wa Jihu saƙo. Faɗi yiwuwar zare ƙwallon ja a karo na biyu idan ja aka zare a farko da dalilinta, sannan yiwuwar ƙwallayen biyun su zama ja.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta ƙwallayen da suka rage a jakar bayan zarewar farko da ja nawa ne.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka tuna yadda layi na 3 na warwarewar ya sami yiwuwar abin da dole ya faru sau biyu, sannan ka saka ƙimar da aka gyara.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Tun da na fara zare ƙwallon ja ban mayar da ita ba ...
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙirga ka rubuta yawan ƙwallayen da suka rage a jaka bayan zarewar farko?
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka nemo yiwuwar ta biyu da ta ƙwallayen biyun su zama ja, kowannensu a matsayin juzu'i?
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin yadda amsar za ta canza idan an mayar da ƙwallon da aka zare?
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.model.0: Tun da na fara zare ja ban mayar da ita ba, ƙwallaye 4 suka rage a jaka kuma guda 1 ja ce. Saboda haka yiwuwar zare ja ta biyu ba 2/5 ba ce, 1/4 ce; yiwuwar duka su zama ja ita ce 2/5 × 1/4 = 1/10.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.model.1: Idan ba a mayar da ƙwallon ba, jimillar ta ragu zuwa 4 a zarewa ta biyu, ja guda ɗaya kaɗai ya rage. Don haka yiwuwar ja ta fito ta biyu ita ce ɗaya bisa huɗu, yiwuwar duka biyun ja kuma ɗaya bisa goma, wato 2/5 ninka da 1/4.
x-m-fill-a-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da aka rubuta juzu'i da kalmomi.

Laburaren ajin Minseo ya ba da littattafai 90 a Maris da littattafai 95 a Afrilu. An zana bayanai iri ɗaya a jadawalin sanduna biyu.

x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yayin da ake ƙara gwadawa, sakamakon yakan kusanci yiwuwar faruwar. Matsakaici ma alama ce.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Jiho ya ce, Mu ce ni ma zan samu maki idan kore ta tsaya. Sabuwar ƙa'ida: idan ja ko kore ta tsaya, Jiho zai samu maki; idan shuɗi ta tsaya, Harin za ta samu maki.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Sassan da Jiho ke samun maki a kansu ja 5 da kore 2 ne, jimilla sassa 7; Harin kuma tana da sassa 5. Idan ƙa'ida ta canza, dole ne a sake tantancewa.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ja da shuɗi suna da adadin sassa iri ɗaya, don haka har yanzu adalci ne.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka ɗauko hukuncin ƙa'idar da ta gabata kai tsaye. Duba ko sassan da Jiho ke samun maki a kansu sun canza saboda an canza ƙa'ida.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Jiho yana da sassa 7, Harin kuma 5, don haka Jiho yana da fa'ida.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka sake ƙirga sassan kowane mutum domin su dace da ƙa'idar da aka canza.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kore sassa 2 ne kawai, don haka ba ya shafar maki.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ko da sassa 2 ne daga cikin 12, suna yin bambanci ga yiwuwar faruwa.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Komai yawan sassan, wanda ya fara juya kibiya ne yake da fa'ida.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s1.reflect: A mataki na 2, me ya sa ba ka canza ƙa'ida ba ko da ka ga bambancin matsakaitan? A mataki na 3, me ya sa ka gyara hukuncinka na farko?
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka bar sabuwar ƙa'ida yadda take (Jiho yana samun maki idan ja ko kore ta tsaya, Harin idan shuɗi ta tsaya), sannan ka sake ƙirƙiri kibiya mai sassa 12 ta yadda 'yan wasan biyun za su sami damar maki iri ɗaya. x-m-fill-a-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta a matsayin furuci adadin sassan da Jiho da Harin suke samun maki a kansu.
x-m-fill-a-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin an raba sassa 12 zuwa sassan da 'yan wasan ke samun maki a kansu da waɗanda ba sa samun maki.

x-m-fill-a-04.s.s2.explain: Dole ne sassan da Jiho ke samun maki a kansu (ja+kore) su yi daidai da sassan da Harin ke samun maki a kansu (shuɗi); saboda haka shuɗi dole ne ya zama sassa 6, ja da kore kuma su zama sassa 6 idan aka haɗa. Akwai amsoshi da dama, dangane da adadin sassan ja da ka zaɓa.
